So, you may not be able to get the $100 no deposit bonus today. However, the above offers are the next best thing. Keep in mind that most casinos will require members to make a deposit before the offer is activated. It’s very rare for casinos to give out a free bonus without anything in return.

What Is a $100 Free Chip Casino Bonus?

The $100 free chip or no deposit bonus is an offer where members are rewarded with $100 bonus money. This offer is activated when they use a specific coupon code.

If you’re rewarded with a $40 no deposit bonus, you may need to continue using the winnings from it until you’ve placed C$1,500 worth of bets.
Instead of a no deposit offer, gamblers are more likely to get free spins or a deposit match.

Types of $100 No Deposit Bonus Codes

Readers will not find a $100 free chip no deposit casino bonus. They can get no deposit bonuses for a smaller amount. Another common no deposit offer is free spins.

No deposit bonuses: This offer rewards with a specific amount of money that can be used in the casino without a deposit. This money is to bet on slots and table games. Members will not be able to withdraw money until it’s been used a specific number of times.
No deposit free spins: Players will be rewarded with free spins on specific games. This offer is often given to returning players as a way to promote certain games on the platform.

$100 No Deposit Bonus and Codes T&Cs

Every no deposit offer available at Canadian online casinos will have terms and conditions. It’s important to review these so you have an idea of how to activate the offer and what the rules are for using it. Let’s take a look at the terms and conditions for using no deposit offers.

Only 18+

All casino members must be 18 years of age or older to use services. Players must verify their age by the casino service if they want to use no deposit offer.

Wagering Requirements

A no deposit offer will have wagering requirements. If you’re given a $100 no deposit offer, you will need to wager it a certain number of times before you can claim any winnings. Gamblers will be required to continue betting their winnings until they meet the wagering requirement. The wagering requirements are generally quite high compared to the bonus. For example, you may receive a $100 no deposit incentive, but you must wager $2,000 or more before you can claim the winnings.

Game Restrictions

When using a no deposit offer, you may notice that certain games are locked. Typically, live dealer games, progressive jackpots, and other speciality games will not be available to players using this offer.

Maximum Win Cap

Many casinos will put a winning cap on this offer. Certain slot games have the potential to pay out over 10,000x what the player wagered. To avoid paying a very high win to a player that hasn’t spent any money at the casino, the no deposit offer will have a maximum win cap.

Bonus Expiration Date

Unfortunately, casino bonuses are only available for a limited time. Members will always be able to find out how long the offer is available when they read the terms and conditions. This will also let them know if they need to use a coupon code to activate the bonus.

Problem Gambling

The Responsible Gambling Council is dedicated to reducing the gambling risks that can lead to a gambling problem. There are more risks of developing a problem now that online casinos are easily available. We have a few tips to help you bet responsibly.

Since there is no guarantee of winning a bet, you should keep your betting limits to an amount you can afford to lose.
Set limits on your account before you play. These include loss limits, deposit limits, and session limits. Don’t be afraid to reach out to customer support.
Never chase a loss. If you’re on a losing streak, quit while you’re ahead.
By Jessica Langille
Chief Editor
Free $100 Casino Chip Canada FAQ
How can I get my free $100 casino chip?

No deposit offers typically come with a coupon code. Players will need to review the casino’s t&cs to learn how to activate the offer.

Where can I find a $100 no deposit bonus?

Casinos will advertise all available bonus offers on their “Promotions” page. You can also come back to our page any time to find out when one of these offers is available.

How can I get $100 no deposit bonus codes?

These offers are very rare. Most legitimate casinos don’t provide this offer. We like to think of such no deposit promo as the unicorn of bonus offers. Many gamblers have heard about it, but have never seen it.

Is a $100 free chip casino scam?

The $100 free chip isn’t a scam. However, it’s more of a myth. While it is possible to use one, it’s very rare for gamblers to find this offer.
